{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum().to_dict())

# Check the data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes
print("Data types:\n", dtypes)

# Check the unique values in the channel column
print("Unique channels:", sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of status
print("Status distribution:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())"}
